notes.text: Initial entries reviewed against linked official schedules on 1 November 2026. DOSM advance-calendar entries do not provide publication times; those remain explicitly unconfirmed.

Dates are displayed in Asia/Kuala_Lumpur; source local dates and timezones are retained in each time/detail field. These are publication schedules, not market predictions. Corrections or cancellations must be appended as revisions; absence from a later source is not a cancellation.
